_comment: Pinned revisions of the external software third_party/fetch.py checks out. Licences and modifications: THIRD_PARTY.md.

exHad.what: Hadronic decays of GeV-scale feebly interacting particles (Kryshtal, Ovchynnikov, arXiv:2609.16104)
exHad.next: python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e . && .venv/bin/python tools/setup.py --pythia8-dir <pythia8317 prefix>; then GRENDEL_EXHAD_PYTHON=<...>/exHad/.venv/bin/python

HNLCalc.what: HNL production and decay rates (Feng, Hewitt, Kling, La Rocco, arXiv:2405.07330); fork with four fixes

FairShip.what: SHiP software HNL modules (python/ only): widths, decay-channel configuration, units
FairShip.next: a PyROOT + Pythia8 environment (ROOT.TPythia8) to run grendel.models.hnl.templates.fairship

SM_HeavyN_CKM_AllMasses_LO.what: HeavyN FeynRules/UFO model v2.2 (Ruiz; arXiv:1602.06957, arXiv:1812.08750)
SM_HeavyN_CKM_AllMasses_LO.next: none; MadGraph converts the model to Python 3 on first import

fonll.what: FONLL 1.3.3 heavy-quark production (Cacciari, Frixione, Nason), the 1.3.3 import of the alisw mirror

MG5_aMC_v3_6_6.next: bin/mg5_aMC completes its own setup on first run; set GRENDEL_MG5_EXE if installed elsewhere; needs LHAPDF 6 with NNPDF40_nlo_as_01180

pythia8315.what: Pythia 8.315 (arXiv:2203.11601); the tracked kaon spectrum reproduces only at this version
